literal_meaning: দ্বিত্বশব্দ যা অল্প বেদনা বা ঝিঁঝিঁ অনুভূতি নির্দেশ করে
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicated word indicating a slight sensation of pain or tingling
example_sentences_in_english: His stomach is twinging with hunger.
My hands are tingling from the cold.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe minor discomforts like hunger pangs.
